bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to aeronautics; prohibiting certain restrictions on fuel distribution; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 360.015, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 360.015, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 21.+]

[+Fuel requirements.+]

[+(a) The commissioner must not establish, including through rulemaking, restrictions for a municipality on fuel distribution at an airport, including but not limited to fuel purchasing, fuel storage, and management of fuel distribution facilities. +]

[+(b) Nothing in this subdivision prevents the establishment of requirements for financial assistance specifically related to fuel facilities. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
